evidence.artifact: desired scroll-policy API test before production implementation
facts: Compilation failed only because ChatScrollPolicy and the consumable SmoothScrollManager API do not yet exist in the compiled application dependency closure.
The test defines near-bottom, away-from-bottom, short-content, request-sequence, and animation-policy contracts.
The existing UI manager remains outside the testable ring closure and still has no ScrollViewProxy consumer.

root_cause: The UI stores an offset as if it were viewport height and emits an internal trigger that no view observes.
residual_risks: Production scroll behavior is intentionally unchanged at this RED checkpoint.
Terminal streaming flags remain a separate blocker.
